cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All those speech lessons from me, and your wedding toast thanked 'the buffet.' The buffet has a name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you cooked. I was trying to keep it short.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered one lesson. Try the one about making people feel appreciated. Start with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll thank you now. Remind me how to pronounce your surname for the guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slowly, like I taught you. Give it a whole sentence; you can borrow the time from 'the buffet.'

reason: Tie the recognition demand to a specific speaking lesson and use B request for pronunciation to give A control of the public acknowledgment.
